scope: budget feasibility path observation -> action mask -> sampling -> log_prob -> rollout -> optimizer -> relay execution

path.fact: remaining_budget_bytes and budget_bytes_per_episode are observation fields only
relay builds SendObservation with budget/capacity remaining
budget_fraction and capacity_fraction are soft features; no attempt_charge_bytes
forced(item) is silence-bound only (age_steps >= MAX_WAIT); no budget term
must=forced -> SEND without likelihood; free candidates multinomial SEND/HOLD even if unaffordable
joint_log_prob weights only free (non-forced); budget-illegal SEND still gets log_prob and entropy
flatten packs features/actions/free/log_prob/advantage with no budget filter
usable is free-set only; PPO loss includes non-executable SEND; refused_by_policy is aggregate-only
budget can_send/why_blocked refuses at emit; transcript refused; sample-level training is not informed
can_send checks sends_per_step and bytes_per_episode; why_blocked returns capacity_step or budget_exhausted

defect_classification.summary: Not a PPO probability bug. Structural gap: budget feasibility is outside the action mask and outside rollout filtering, so unaffordable SEND still occupies actor likelihood; training records cannot recover true dual-action-free counts.
defect_classification.next_if_defect_branch: fix training path first (mask or sample filter + instrumentation fields); do not continue communication-effect experiments until fixed
